[RB-BAD-CHANGE#02] Bad change and configuration regression > Signature in the data: A change record. In the change log, a `config_push` or `parameter_tuning` row on an aggregation router (which affects every site below it) or on each site of a group. Its status later reads `rolled_back`. The description can be bland, such as "scheduled parameter optimisation batch", so do not judge it by its wording. A step at the change time. ... What stays normal. ...
[RB-BAD-CHANGE#05] Bad change and configuration regression > Verification steps: 1. `get_anomalies` for `rrc_success_pct` and `drop_rate_pct` on a set of sites; read the start time. 2. `get_topology`: find the common ancestor of the affected sites (aggregation router or link). 3. ... 4. `query_kpis`: confirm availability is 100 % and the RRC step is aligned with the change. Use sites outside the changed subtree as a control group; they must be normal. ...
[RB-CHANGE-CORRELATION#07] Change correlation policy > Upgrades and tuning: Software upgrades often run at night and restart equipment, which can cause short availability dips at the time. Those are expected if the upgrade fits the time. A regression that persists after an upgrade is a separate matter; see the upgrade regression runbook. Parameter tuning is usually neutral. It matters only if its timing and shape fit.
[RB-CONGESTION#03] Radio capacity congestion > Differential diagnosis: Versus a stadium event or other expected demand An event also brings users, high PRB and `HIGH_PRB` alarms. Look in `external_events` for a record covering the time and the region, and check whether the site is near the venue (`nodes.attrs.near_venue`). ... Versus a normal busy hour ... A bad change lowers RRC success with PRB normal or lower and no user increase. ...

result.markdown:
# Call setup failures and dropped sessions at S-SFX-002

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `AGG-SFX-01`
- **Confidence:** high (Timing directly follows the change, scope matches all sites under the aggregation router, and maintenance and external events were ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-10 03:30 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-10 03:29
- **Affected:** S-SFX-002, S-SFX-004, S-SFX-005, S-SFX-006, S-SFX-008, S-SFX-010

## Summary

Pushing RAN parameter template RT-2.5 to AGG-SFX-01 introduced an admission control and RRC timer configuration regression.

Call setup failures and dropped sessions rose across six sites under AGG-SFX-01 starting at 03:30 and remain ongoing.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-10 03:29: Pushed RAN parameter template RT-2.5 to AGG-SFX-01. [CHG-2026-0029]
- 2026-09-10 03:30: Anomaly alert ALR-0010 started for 6 sites including S-SFX-002. [ALR-0010]
- 2026-09-10 03:30: Earliest KPI onset with drop_rate_pct above baseline at S-SFX-002. [T5]
- 2026-09-10 03:46: Minor RRC failure rate high alarm raised on S-SFX-008. [ALM-000207]
- 2026-09-10 03:58: Minor RRC failure rate high alarm raised on S-SFX-005. [ALM-000208]
- 2026-09-10 04:01: Minor RRC failure rate high alarm raised on S-SFX-006. [ALM-000209]

## Evidence

- Deviation occurred in 6 of 6 series with earliest onset at 2026-09-10 03:30. [T5]
- Change CHG-2026-0029 executed at 2026-09-10 03:29 pushing parameter template RT-2.5 to AGG-SFX-01. [CHG-2026-0029]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on S-SFX-002, AGG-SFX-01 and its parents during the window. [T9]
- No external events occurred for region SFX between 2026-09-09 18:00 and 2026-09-10 08:47. [T11]
- Active minor alarms for high RRC failure rate were raised on multiple sites below AGG-SFX-01. [T8]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at AGG-SFX-01: confirmed. Parameter template RT-2.5 pushed at 03:29 perfectly matches the anomaly onset at 03:30 across all dependent sites. [CHG-2026-0029, T5]
2. **transport_degradation** at LNK-SFX-01-A: rejected. Link degradation alarm started much later at 06:39 and cleared quickly, unrelated to the 03:30 incident onset. [ALM-000210]

## Ruled out

- CHG-2026-0030: Occurred at 05:14, which is after the incident start time of 03:30.
- ALM-000210: Occurred at 06:39 after the incident had already begun at 03:30 and cleared shortly after.

## Recommended actions

- Roll back CHG-2026-0029 on AGG-SFX-01 immediately.
- Monitor RRC success rate and drop rate KPIs on S-SFX-002 following rollback.

## Sources

- `CHG-2026-0029`: parameter_tuning on AGG-SFX-01 at 2026-09-10 03:29: Push RAN parameter template RT-2.5 to AGG-SFX-01 (admission control, RRC timers) [in effect (not rolled back)]
